notes: Neighbour products -x_i*x_{i+1} by a queue fold (closures (uncons x mul) popping the negated list), minus 1 so a break is negative, the breaks alone, their suffix sums (prefix-sum idiom) as group keys, then the largest multiplicity of a key by a cross product (entries (key eq?) followed by every key, filtered by their head) and the filter-fold minimum of the negated counts. The final 0 entry of the suffix sums supplies the +1 for the last group, so the multiplicity is exactly 1 + the run. O(n^2).
